items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: He let me have his apartment to do the writing. And then he came and helped me by doing some copying for me.

ctx.x: The pianist, a wonderful pianist. He let me have his apartment to do the writing. And then he came and helped me by doing some copying for me. Because those guys, I’ll never forget them because they were great at a time when I knew nothing.
